text: Pentland Group describes itself as 'a family business building and delivering positive brands in sports, outdoor and fashion' with annual sales of $8 billion; its Pentland Brands arm 'owns Speedo, Berghaus, Canterbury, Endura, ellesse, SeaVees, Red Or Dead and Mitre'.
short: Mitre is owned by Pentland Brands, part of family-owned Pentland Group.
